## About
Sid Cunningham Dentistry is a small practice in Century South Center on East William Cannon Drive in Austin. Dr. Sidney K. Cunningham, DDS, sees patients alongside Lisa, his office manager, and Ginger, his dental hygienist.
We believe dentistry starts with prevention, so we recommend regular cleanings and exams for every patient. When a tooth needs more care, the dentist will help you choose the best solution for it.
Patients tell us they come back because they feel taken care of and never pushed into work they don't need. We hold a 4.9 rating from 119 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to meet you.

## Services
- Cleaning and Prevention: Regular cleanings and examinations to keep problems from starting.
- Crowns, Bridges, and Veneers: For a damaged or decayed tooth, the dentist will help you choose the best solution.
- Night Guards: Custom snore and night guards fitted to your bite, for jaw clenching and bruxism.
- Periodontal Maintenance: Removing plaque and tartar from above and below the gumline to manage gum disease.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the office?
A: We're in Century South Center on East William Cannon Drive in Austin.

Q: Is the office open on Friday?
A: No. The office is closed on Friday.

Q: What cleanings and examinations do you recommend?
A: We recommend biannual cleanings and examinations for all patients.
